Flow.description: Bare-bones passthrough. Launched via quick action on a GiftCommitment record — Salesforce implicitly injects the GC Id as recordId. This flow does nothing but hand that Id to the shared monolith FQS_Gift_Entry_Single_Launcher_Account as BOTH recordId (initial value, immediately overwritten by the monolith's Assign_Context_Entry with the commitment's DonorId) AND contextCommitmentId (drives Decide_Entry_Mode's GC-context branch: Get_GC_Context loads the GC into rsv_SelectedCommitment via outputReference, then the Pledge Payment leaf pre-selects and jumps past Screen_Category to Screen_Existing_GTs). No local screens, no payability check (Flexipage visibility rule handles that upstream), no error handling (monolith owns the full experience). Monolith's Screen_Success is terminal — no duplicate confirmation.
Flow.label: FQS Gift Entry Guide — GiftCommitment

subflows.name: Sub_Monolith
subflows.label: Record Pledge Payment (Guided)
subflows.description: Delegates directly to FQS_Gift_Entry_Single_Launcher_Account. Passes the quick-action-injected recordId (which IS the GC Id on this surface) as BOTH the monolith's recordId (transient — overwritten by Assign_Context_Entry to DonorId) AND contextCommitmentId (persistent — triggers the GC-context branch through Decide_Entry_Mode). No further wiring needed on this side; the monolith fully owns the experience.

variables.name: recordId
variables.description: Input: Id of the GiftCommitment from which the flow is launched. Passed automatically by the Lightning quick action (standard implicit behavior — no action-config binding required).
